snippet.title: Ultimate Arcade: Squeaky (Flash Game) Gameplay
snippet.description:
I saw this on a Flashpoint Archive recommendation, and I thought to myself; "Maybe I should give it a try". Squeaky was a flash game by a now-defunct flash gaming label "Ultimate Arcade", where you help the light-green shirted robot into watching out for bombs while collecting oil. After collecting all, wait for that light blue UFO ship to pick the robot up to the next level. This flash game is very challenging because I stumble upon bombs and I need to be very careful not to land on them, or I'm in serious trouble. It took me like 2 hours to get this through. Anyways, who remembers this one?

Platforms:
Flashpoint Archive - https://flashpointarchive.org/
Y8 Browser - https://www.y8.com/games/squeaky

Link below:
https://www.addictinggames.com/funny/squeaky
